::: {.org-render .transparent style="margin: 0; justify-content: center;" header="Distribution Softmax Dynamique"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const vocab = [
    { word: "Intelligence", logit: 8.0 },
    { word: "Chat", logit: 7.5 },
    { word: "Code", logit: 6.0 },
    { word: "Robot", logit: 5.0 },
    { word: "Erreur", logit: 4.0 },
    { word: "Pizza", logit: 1.0 },
    { word: "Soleil", logit: 0.5 },
    { word: "Arbre", logit: 0.1 }
  ];
  const maxLogit = d3.max(vocab, d => d.logit);
  let items = vocab.map(d => ({ ...d, score: Math.exp((d.logit - maxLogit) / temp) }));
  let sumScore = d3.sum(items, d => d.score);
  items.forEach(d => d.prob = d.score / sumScore);
  items.sort((a, b) => b.prob - a.prob);
  items.forEach((d, i) => { if (i >= topK) d.prob = 0; });
  let cumulative = 0;
  let pCutoffReached = false;
  items.forEach(d => {
    if (pCutoffReached || d.prob <= 0) {
      d.prob = 0;
    } else {
      cumulative += d.prob;
      if (cumulative >= topP) pCutoffReached = true;
    }
  });
  let finalSum = d3.sum(items, d => d.prob);
  items.forEach(d => d.prob = finalSum > 0 ? Math.min(1, d.prob / finalSum) : 0);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 400,
    height: 250,
    marginLeft: 80,
    style: { background: "transparent", color: theme.base1 },
    x: { domain: [0, 1], tickFormat: ".0%", label: "Probabilité (%)" },
    y: { label: null, domain: items.map(d => d.word) },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(items, { x: "prob", y: "word", fill: d => d.prob > 0 ? (d.prob > 0.5 ? theme.green : theme.blue) : theme.base02, rx: 4 }),
      Plot.text(items, { x: "prob", y: "word", text: d => d.prob > 0 ? (d.prob * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "Exclu", textAnchor: "start", dx: 5, fill: theme.base1 })
    ]
  });
}
```

::: {.results header="Configuration de l'Échantillonnage"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // 1. Temperature Card
  const tempStatus = temp < 0.4 ? "warning" : (temp > 1.4 ? "success" : "info");
  const tempCard = ui.card(html`
    <div class="card-metric-container position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="position-relative z-2">
        <div class="card-metric-label">Température</div>
        <div class="card-metric-value" style="color: ${tempStatus === 'warning' ? theme.yellow : (tempStatus === 'success' ? theme.orange : theme.blue)};">${temp.toFixed(2)}</div>
        <div class="small opacity-75 mt-2" style="line-height: 1.3;">
          ${temp < 0.4
            ? "<b>Déterministe</b>. Distribution pincée, focus sur la logique pure."
            : (temp > 1.4
              ? "<b>Créatif</b>. Distribution aplatie, focus sur l'originalité."
              : "<b>Équilibré</b>. Navigation fluide entre logique et variabilité.")
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `, { status: tempStatus });

  // 2. Top-K Card
  const kStatus = topK <= 3 ? "warning" : "info";
  const kCard = ui.card(html`
    <div class="card-metric-container position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="position-relative z-2">
        <div class="card-metric-label">Top-K (Candidates)</div>
        <div class="card-metric-value" style="color: ${theme.cyan};">${topK}</div>
        <div class="small opacity-75 mt-2" style="line-height: 1.3;">
          ${topK <= 3
            ? "<b>Cercle Restreint</b>. Seul le haut du panier est autorisé."
            : "<b>Large Éventail</b>. Le modèle explore une plus grande diversité."
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `, { status: kStatus });

  // 3. Top-P Card
  const pStatus = topP < 0.6 ? "warning" : "info";
  const pCard = ui.card(html`
    <div class="card-metric-container position-relative overflow-hidden">
      <div class="position-relative z-2">
        <div class="card-metric-label">Top-P (Nucleus)</div>
        <div class="card-metric-value" style="color: ${theme.yellow};">${(topP * 100).toFixed(0)}%</div>
        <div class="small opacity-75 mt-2" style="line-height: 1.3;">
          ${topP < 0.6
            ? "<b>Nucleus Serré</b>. On ne garde que le cœur de la probabilité."
            : "<b>Masse Ouverte</b>. La traîne de probabilité est conservée."
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `, { status: pStatus });

  return html`<div class="d-flex flex-row gap-3 w-100 flex-wrap">
    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">${tempCard}</div>
    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">${kCard}</div>
    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">${pCard}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```
